Export a dataset with its provenance

Source: R/export.R
btg_export.Rd

Writes the rows of a dataset to a CSV file and, beside it, a JSON sidecar that records the release, the source month, the SHA-256 checksums of the bundled payloads, the selection, the citation and the documented limitations, so that a file passed on by email or attached to a report still says exactly where its numbers came from.

Usage

btg_export(x, path, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A dataset from btg_get_data().

path

Path of the CSV file to write. The sidecar takes the same name with the extension .json, and the monthly coverage table, when the dataset has one, the suffix -coverage.csv.

overwrite

Whether to replace existing files.

Value

A character vector of the written paths, invisibly.

Examples

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
btg_export(btg_get_data(force = c("metropolitan", "kent")), path)
list.files(dirname(path), basename(sub("[.]csv$", "", path)))
#> [1] "file199142b8eb54-coverage.csv" "file199142b8eb54.csv"         
#> [3] "file199142b8eb54.json"        
unlink(list.files(dirname(path), basename(sub("[.]csv$", "", path)), full.names = TRUE))
